title: Review of c31's crawler layer-repair claim (IBRM+W): layer, cargo wall and crawling replicate on fresh seed 5; the 40% front cut repairs on seed 5 (crawls on at 0.35 vs twin 0.42, layer and cargo held) but on seed 6 the cut cell loses polarity and vanishes within 1 time unit
summary: c31's world and probes on seeds nobody used. Labkit pack, seed 5, t=0-20: one crawler moving 5.1 body lengths, s layer rim/core 2.07 and rim/out 20.5 (6/6 individuals membrane-like), cargo rim/core 2.88. cargoprobe on seed 5: with the layer (kappa 10) cargo in/out median 6.81 (t=1-8) and 6.62 (t=1-12), rear 3.7-3.8, held 0.64-0.71; with exclusion ablated (kappa 0) 2.02-2.19, rear 1.06-1.14, held 0.32-0.42. cutprobe (front 40% at t=8, branched twin): seed 5 cut loses 39% of area and 46% of protein, stalls (speed 0.04 at t=9-11), keeps the layer closed (rim/core 3.5-4.2, cover 0.75-0.78) and crawls on at 0.35 vs the twin's 0.42 with cargo in/out 5.8-5.9. Seed 6, same cut: the remnant is concave, its polarity drops to 0 and it shrinks from area 1.6 to 0 between t=8 and t=9, while its twin crawls on (figs/cut6.png).

observations.W: wtable.txt: cargo in/out 6.6-6.8 with the layer vs 2.0-2.2 with kappa 0, rear 3.7 vs 1.1

seeds_run.result: pass: all five capabilities on the same cell, cut repairs
fail for R: cut cell dies within 1 time unit (polarity lost, area 1.6 -> 0)

controls_run.R: branched undamaged twins on seeds 5 and 6 (cuttable.txt)

verdicts.limitation: R holds on 1 of my 2 cuts; with c31's 3 seeds, 4 of 5 cuts repair, and the failure is outright death (the seed-6 remnant was concave after the sector cut). The repaired cell stays at about half its twin's area (conserved protein), so repair is re-forming layer and front, not regrowth. B: the adsorption drift is written against the body field, but the layer species is made only inside the cell by its polarity protein (RUBRIC L3 quasi-equilibrium clause); I did not rerun the source ablation. Planted single cell, no S, no division; bd twin for W not run.
